## Final Accepted Amendments

### `fr-6-79fe1b13`

The runtime carbon conservation guard (`tick_has_closed_system_carbon` in engine.rs:551-562) is effectively disabled on every tick where the chemistry system produces nonzero DIC flux. With default ProcessParams (zero DIC exchange rates), the guard works. But any preset configuration that enables atmospheric CO2 exchange (nonzero `respiration_dic_rate_mg_c_per_g_per_hour` or `photosynthesis_dic_rate_mg_c_per_g_per_hour`) silently disables carbon conservation enforcement for the entire tick, meaning carbon leaks in OTHER systems (plant growth, algae, shrimp, etc.) go undetected at runtime. The test suite catches such leaks because it uses zeroed rates, but production gameplay does not benefit from the guard. Consider: (a) adding a code comment documenting this as a known limitation for downstream beads (tanksim-6e5.1.2.4 tracing, tanksim-6e5.3.4 bookkeeping audit), or (b) in a future bead, tracking atmospheric exchange as an explicit BudgetEntry source/sink so the guard can subtract it from the carbon delta rather than disabling the check entirely.
